scope.name: Clothing Reference to Garment Proposal Adapter
in_scope: user-supplied clothing reference evidence intake for visible garments
bounded classification and slicing/region proposals that map observable clothing evidence into editable FGA-PARAM-1 garment values
confidence, uncertainty, unsupported and unresolved evidence diagnostics without inventing hidden garment detail
explicit owner/user review and editing before any proposal may become garment state
reuse of FGA-02 topology-fit diagnostics and the FGA-04 Fashion Design Studio after explicit proposal acceptance
out_of_scope: automatic canonical truth or silent wardrobe commit
generative image synthesis or a new renderer
PAPT asset generation or paid production execution
